newsitem.title: USA: Old Guard declines to consider Donegal bid.
newsitem.headline: Old Guard declines to consider Donegal bid.

text.p: Donegal Group Inc, which has proposed buying Old Guard Group, said on Thursday Old Guard had declined to consider the bid further, believing the offer was inconsistent with Old Guard's plan of independence.
Old Guard also requested Donegal withdraw its application, Donegal said.
Donegal said it had declined to withdraw it.
Donegal proposed merging the Old Guard Group with one of its subsidiaries and distributing $27.5 million to Old Guard policy holders instead of issuing non-transferable subscription rights.
